title: The dream of four Zoots
summary: He dreamed four Zoot Sims playing a solo in harmony, which inspired the altos album.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: (Tape went blank for a few seconds)
--you mean whether that was before the Zoot thing or after the Zoot thing?
The Zoot thing was in about '51 or '52 or something like that.
Was it '51? I thought it was '55.
Don't take my word for it.
I think the Zoot thing was '55 and the By George was '54, so it would have been before the Zoot thing.
Talk about the Zoot thing a little bit.
Yeah. The one that was indeed born in a dream.

went to sleep one night and dreamt that I walked into a night club and there was a little stage there and there were four Zoots standing on the stage all playing alto saxophones and they were all playing the same jazz solo, simultaneously in perfect harmony, very beautiful jazz harmony. And it sounded like a flight of birds to me, in the dream, and it was so exciting that I suddenly realized that I was dreaming and I woke myself up and I sat up, trying to figure out how to make this a reality, how to really get that sound.
You hadn't realized that you had just invented super sax twenty years too soon.
Isn't that wild? Isn't that wild?
Yeah, because Med Flory did that years later; right. I dreamt it; that's what is so beautiful about it.
